title: Sequence-Augmented SE(3)-Flow Matching For Conditional Protein Backbone Generation
tldr_zh: FoldFlow-2 用 pLM 序列条件化 SE(3)-FM，无条件生成全面超 RFDiffusion，并解锁折叠与 scaffolding
tldr_en: FoldFlow-2 conditions SE(3)-flow matching on pLM-encoded sequences, outperforming RFDiffusion on unconditional generation and enabling folding/scaffolding
